description: Source code for the FastAPI router handling session-related API endpoints in a backend project. It includes route handlers for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, deleting sessions, and posting messages, interfacing with Supabase for data storage and retrieval.

methods.name: get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates a Supabase client using environment variables for configuration.

methods.name: list_sessions(user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Lists all sessions for the current authenticated user.

methods.name: create_session(payload: SessionCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Creates a new session for the current user, ensuring RLS policies are satisfied.

methods.name: get_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific session by ID along with its messages.

methods.name: update_session(session_id: str, payload: SessionUpdate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Updates a session's title if provided, ensuring ownership and proper permissions.

methods.name: delete_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
post_message(session_id: str, payload: MessageCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Posts a user message within a session, requiring at least one associated file, and replies with a stub assistant message.
